PreceptDef.label: occasional
PreceptDef.description: Those who know the teachings of the Seven should share them when the time and company are appropriate.

PreceptDef.label: Gathering of the Seven
PreceptDef.description: A worship gathering in which the Faithful invoke each of the Seven, hear words of guidance, and celebrate together.

PreceptDef.label: Mother's Mercy
PreceptDef.description: A charity-themed gathering honoring the Mother's mercy through fellowship, promises of aid, and care for those in need.

PreceptDef.label: Stranger's Farewell
PreceptDef.description: The Faithful gather at a believer's grave to mourn, commend the departed to the Stranger, and say their final farewells. If the body is lost, an empty grave may be used.
PreceptDef.extraTextPawnDeathLetter: {PAWN_nameDef} should be buried and given the Stranger's Farewell so the Faithful may mourn and commend {PAWN_objective} to the Stranger.
